author: Sir_Elric
what_it_is: This file contains 6 "careers", each with 4 "custom" skaters. Each one is actually a hidden skater (Neversoft Dev, family, or created)
format: DexDrive .gme: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header (per-block comments) + 131072-byte raw card; the card holds 6 save(s), 6 for this game (BASLUS-01066NJL1G01, BASLUS-01066NKH2G01, BASLUS-01066NJK3G01, BASLUS-01066NIH4G01, ...)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/psx-card.py card.mcr tony-hawks-pro-skater-2.995.gme: unwraps the card (DexDrive .gme: 3904-byte header + card)
